en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Abu Zahir, from Al Hassan Bin Musa Al Kshhab, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [6:82] Those who believe and do not mix up their faith with injustice.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘With whatever Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> came with from the Wilayah, and they are not mixing it with the Wilayah of so and so, and so and so, so it is ‘mixing up ‘بِالظُّلْمِ’ with the injustice’’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from abu Zahir from al-Hassan ibn Musa al-Khashshab from Ali ibn Hassa’n from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “Those who have accepted the faith and have kept it pure from injustice, have achieved security and guidance.” [6:82]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to faith in that Prophet Muhammad (s.a) has brought from Allah about Wilaya, Leadership with Divine Authority and have not mixed it with the authority of so and so that is mixing with injustice.”
